entries.text: Adds CHANGELOG.md entries for the 3.47.9 stable hotfix (#195073, #194959, #195015). CI-only cherry-picks are omitted. Tracker: #195427 Edits to cherry-pick changelog descriptions #195073 and #195015: used verbatim from the cherry-pick PR's "Changelog Description". #194959 (@bkonyi): edited to follow Hotfix Documentation Best Practices (describe the state prior to the fix): Original: "When running flutter test in pub workspaces, monorepos, or symlinked directories, fix a StateError crash during native assets compilation by falling back to appName matching." Changelog: "When running flutter test in pub workspaces, monorepos, or symlinked directories on any platform, native assets compilation crashed with a StateError." Changes: rewrote as the pre-fix behavior, added "on any platform", dropped the implementation detail ("falling back to appName matching"). @bkonyi FYI — please let us know if the edited wording for #194959 looks right.
